theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α lam M K : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Rn n → Rn ℓ) (ah : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Ψ : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e : ℕ → Rn n) (R c d : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → Tendsto R atTop atTop → Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (W k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, W k 0 = 0) → (∀ k, fderiv ℝ (W k) 0 = 0) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ‖fderiv ℝ (W k) z - fderiv ℝ (W k) z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) => ah k p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) ×ˢ univ)) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (Ψ k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ ah k 0 P P) → (∀ k, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |ah k 0 P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |ah k z P Q - ah k 0 P Q| ≤ c k * ‖z‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Ψ k z Q| ≤ d k * ‖z‖ ^ α * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ah k z (fderiv ℝ (W k) z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), Ψ k z (fderiv ℝ ζ z)) → (∀ k, ‖e k‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ‖fderiv ℝ (W k) (e k)‖ = 1) → ∃ (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (W' : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ A P P) ∧ (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |A P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 W' ∧ (∀ z z' : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W' z - fderiv ℝ W' z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) ∧ (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ z, A (fderiv ℝ W' z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = 0) ∧ fderiv ℝ W' 0 = 0 ∧ ∃ e₀ : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W' e₀‖ = 1
